cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A directs B to treat kettle failure as a labor dispute and authorizes a seat concession to obtain tea.
confusable: Unlike speaking whimsically about a broken appliance, A recruits specific negotiating actions under the impossible explanation.
comparison: A helpful meeting invitation becomes a bargaining concession, unlike replacing a surveyor's concrete with a guiding truck.
seedUse: The seed already assigns negotiation language and grants A's own chair, giving S01 control of the practical response.
